Alger, 3 septembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, September 3, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The Minister of Posts and Telecommunications chaired a meeting with sector officials to activate natural disaster preparedness mechanisms. A series of measures was announced to guarantee the continuity of telecom services in the event of a crisis.
Le ministre des Postes et des Télécommun: The Minister of Posts and Telecommunications, Sid Ali Zirourki, led a scoping meeting with sector officials at both the central and local levels. The stated objective: to strengthen the preparedness of the postal and telecom sector and ensure service continuity in the event of natural disasters or major crises.
Plusieurs actions prioritaires ont été a: Several priority actions were agreed upon during this meeting. Among them, the establishment of a reserve stock of mobile stations and technical equipment to enable rapid intervention. A unified information platform was also commissioned to monitor the extent of damage and the pace of service restoration in real time. In addition, the minister demanded the immediate activation of the Cell Broadcast system to issue early warnings to citizens in affected areas.
Sid Ali Zirourki a insisté sur la nécess: Sid Ali Zirourki emphasized the need to move from a reactive logic to a proactive approach. Interventions must no longer be limited to post-disaster response, but must rely on standardized protocols combining preparedness, coordination, and swift action. These measures aim to secure essential services, protect infrastructure, and ultimately save human lives.
